risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Demand for the Company's products may be adversely affected by economic downturns in key user industries; margin pressure can arise from shifts in the demand-supply balance, heightened domestic and international competition, volatile raw material prices, and shifts in product preferences.
- Petrochemical- and pigment-linked feedstocks (TiO2, carbon black, synthetic organic pigments) represent 55-65% of masterbatch production cost and remain exposed to crude oil price swings and geopolitical shocks.
- Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates are a significant factor affecting profitability, given exposure between imports and exports; the Company employs hedging strategies to manage this.
- Extended credit terms to customers create exposure to payment delays or defaults; mitigated by customer financial-health monitoring, receivables tracking and ECGC insurance on export sales.
- The market is highly competitive with minimal barriers to entry for new players, pressuring cost efficiency, quality and customer retention.
- Continued US tariff uncertainty and a soft EU manufacturing/export outlook may dampen demand from the Company's European and US-linked fiber and plastics customers.
- The Middle East conflict and Russia-related sanctions spillover have already contributed to feedstock price volatility during the year and remain an ongoing risk to supply chains.
- Tightening global regulatory frameworks (REACH restrictions, OEKO-TEX revisions, EU Digital Product Passport/ESPR) require sustained investment in regulatory infrastructure to avoid loss of market access.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Protect margins through disciplined feedstock procurement, inventory planning and vendor diversification amid continued price volatility
- Deepen regulatory compliance capability to capture compliance-driven export opportunities and safeguard existing customer relationships
- Leverage significantly scaled R&D and sample development capacity to secure new business faster than competition
- Continue evaluating new growth avenues including recycled-content masterbatches, rPET-based products, and dope-dyeing solutions for sustainability-focused textile brands
